records.bodyZh: 机器赢了棋，人们就开始问它明天会不会来上班。棋友回了一句：先别急，下棋的规矩可比我们办公室清楚。
records.bodyEn: A machine wins at Go, and people ask whether it will turn up at work tomorrow. A player replies: not so fast—the rules on a board are much clearer than the rules in our office.

records.bodyZh:
路边棋盘：我倒想拿它陪我复盘。输给谁都行，能告诉我哪步走坏了最好。
纸飞机：会赢和会教人，还真是两件事。
records.bodyEn:
Board by the Road: I'd like it to review my games. I don't mind losing if I can learn where I went wrong.
Paper Plane: Winning and teaching someone are two different skills.

records.titleEn: One screenshot of a correct answer
records.bodyZh: 站长贴出一个虚构问答案例，下面留着“还没试过的问题”。评论：这栏比那个大大的“成功”更想让我继续看。
records.bodyEn: A blog presents a fictional question-and-answer example, followed by “Questions not tried yet.” A comment reads: this part makes me want to keep reading more than the big SUCCESS heading.

records.bodyZh: 卖家：旧显卡一张，只保证我实际测过的接口正常。最近问“能不能养个会聊天的电脑”的人多了，我也不敢替软件打包票。
records.bodyEn: Seller: One used graphics card. I can only guarantee the ports I tested. More people have been asking whether it can run a talking computer. I can't make promises on behalf of the software.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：看新闻说聊天程序被人带坏了。
群友乙：真放到网上，来聊天的人可不会都按说明书说话。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: I saw news about people steering a chat program into trouble.
Member B: Once it's online, people won't all talk to it according to the instructions.

records.titleEn: The machine says yes. Who signs?
records.bodyZh: 有人想让程序帮忙筛表格，也有人问，被它筛掉的一行能不能找回来。讨论最后停在一个很小的问题：申诉按钮放哪儿？
records.bodyEn: Some people want software to sort forms; others ask whether a rejected row can be recovered. The discussion settles on a small question: where does the appeal button go?

records.bodyZh:
半页纸：我先把题目和答案都留着，错了还能复查。
晚班车：最好连“没把握”也能记下来，别把每个空格都逼成是或否。
records.bodyEn:
Half a Page: I keep the questions and answers so mistakes can be checked later.
Late Bus: Keep uncertainty too. Don't force every blank into yes or no.

records.bodyZh: 这份演示只测了所列情形。没测过的不等于没问题。站长把这两句放到下载按钮上方，留言有人嫌啰嗦，也有人说终于知道该拿它干什么。
records.bodyEn: This demo has only been tested in the listed situations. Untested does not mean trouble-free. The owner puts those lines above Download. Some readers call it wordy; others finally know what it is for.

records.bodyZh: 招临时整理：先分二十份表格，有疑问的另放，不要替我猜。留言：如果用程序先分一遍，还按同样价钱算吗？卖家还没回答。
records.bodyEn: Temporary sorting job: sort twenty forms first; set uncertain ones aside instead of guessing. A comment asks: if software does a first pass, is the pay the same? The poster hasn't answered yet.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：今天看到篇文章，程序完成目标，也可能顺手把别的事搞坏。
群友乙：像只催快点不问质量？那这题我们单位也没答好。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: I read an article about a program meeting its goal while causing other trouble.
Member B: Like demanding speed without asking about quality? My workplace hasn't solved that either.

records.bodyZh: 同一张照片被标成“工作”和“休闲”。有人觉得只是分类小错，有人说，若这些标签影响推荐和机会，小错也会累起来。
records.bodyEn: The same photo is labelled both work and leisure. Some call it a small classification error; others say small errors add up when labels affect recommendations and opportunities.

records.bodyZh:
纸飞机：新闻里的词也有旧偏见，喂给机器就会变中立吗？
旧散热器：那得看看它把哪些词摆在一起，别只看分数高了没有。
records.bodyEn:
Paper Plane: News language carries old prejudices. Does feeding it to a machine make it neutral?
Old Heatsink: We should inspect the associations it learns, not just whether its score goes up.

records.bodyZh: 读者指出，页面把雨伞写成了手杖。站长留下原句和改动日期。另一个读者说：“错过也看得见，我倒更愿意再来。”
records.bodyEn: A reader points out that the page called an umbrella a walking stick. The owner keeps the original line and the correction date. Another reader says: “Being able to see the mistake makes me more willing to come back.”

records.bodyZh:
买家：自动识图说这是某个稀有版本，能按那个价格卖吗？
卖家：先拍清楚背面型号吧。识图的说法不能当鉴定书。
records.bodyEn:
Buyer: Image recognition says this is a rare edition. Can it sell for that price?
Seller: Take a clear photo of the model number first. A label from software isn't an appraisal.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：程序把我的猫认成了拖把。
群友乙：发出来是挺好笑，拿同一套东西认人可就没这么轻松了。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: A program called my cat a mop.
Member B: That's funny as a screenshot. Using the same sort of thing to label people feels less harmless.

records.bodyZh: 一位网友说聊天程序让夜班没那么难熬；另一位问，程序答得亲切时，使用者能不能看见它的局限。两句话都被顶了上来。
records.bodyEn: One reader says a chat program makes the night shift less lonely. Another asks whether users can still see its limits when it sounds kind. Both comments receive attention.

records.bodyZh:
半页纸：机器帮忙起的草稿，署名怎么写？
纸飞机：我愿意改稿，但想让读者知道谁负责。
晚班车：别让“机器写的”变成不用纠错的理由。
records.bodyEn:
Half a Page: How should we credit a machine-assisted draft?
Paper Plane: I'll edit it, but readers should know who is responsible.
Late Bus: “The machine wrote it” shouldn't be an excuse to leave errors in place.

records.bodyZh: “部分初稿由程序辅助，内容由本站核对。”留言：这行字不算保修，但至少知道该找谁问。
records.bodyEn: “Some drafts use software assistance. This site checks the content.” A reader comments: that isn't a warranty, but at least I know whom to ask.

records.bodyZh:
文案服务留言：句子写得顺，别把没测过的功能也写进去。
回复：可以润色，不能替商品长出本来没有的本事。
records.bodyEn:
Comment on a copywriting listing: Smooth sentences are fine, but don't add features nobody tested.
Reply: Polish the wording; don't give the product abilities it doesn't have.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：客服回得跟真人一样，我差点把一长串事情全告诉它。
群友乙：像不像人先放一边，哪些内容会留下，总该先说明白。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: The help chat sounded so human that I nearly told it everything.
Member B: Human-sounding or not, it should explain what it keeps before you start.

records.titleZh: 译文顺了，就可以不看原文了吗？
records.titleEn: If the translation reads smoothly, can we stop checking the original?
records.bodyZh: 新翻译系统的论文引来关注。网友举了自己编的例子：一句里的“不要”若漏掉，句子再流畅也得重来。
records.bodyEn: A paper on a new translation system draws attention. A reader makes up an example: omit a single “do not,” and fluency won't save the result.

records.bodyZh:
纸飞机：翻译工具能帮我先理一遍，但交出去的东西我还得看。
晚班车：如果大家觉得只要按一下按钮，核对的时间由谁付？
records.bodyEn:
Paper Plane: Translation tools help with a first pass, but I still check what I deliver.
Late Bus: If everyone thinks it only takes one click, who pays for the checking time?

records.bodyZh: 这个词的译法已改；旧版保留在历史记录里。留言：“以前从这儿抄走的人，会知道改过吗？”站长把更正放到了首页。
records.bodyEn: This term has been corrected; the old version remains in the history. A reader asks: “Will people who copied it earlier know?” The owner adds a correction notice to the home page.

records.bodyZh:
翻译兼职留言：可用工具，交付前须逐项复核数字和否定词。
应聘者：那就把复核也算工时吧，不能只给“按按钮”的价。
records.bodyEn:
Translation gig note: Tools allowed. Check numbers and negations before delivery.
Applicant: Then count the checking as work, rather than paying only for pressing a button.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：它还记得我上回随口说的话，我一开始挺高兴。
群友乙：后来呢？
群友甲：后来想知道，能不能让它忘掉。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: It remembered something I mentioned last time. At first I was pleased.
Member B: And then?
Member A: Then I wanted to know whether I could ask it to forget.

records.titleZh: 给人使用、给人副本、再等一等
records.titleEn: Let people use it, give them a copy, or wait
records.bodyZh: 有人想先开小范围试用，有人想公开研究材料，也有人说先补测试。帖子没有投票宣布赢家，只列出三种做法各自还没答完的问题。
records.bodyEn: Some suggest a limited trial, some want research materials released, and others want more tests first. The thread does not vote for a winner. It lists the questions each approach leaves open.

records.bodyZh:
半页纸：能下载不等于我跑得动。
旧散热器：能跑也不等于会修。
纸飞机：但能看清改过什么，至少比只听一句“相信我们”强。
records.bodyEn:
Half a Page: Being able to download it doesn't mean I can run it.
Old Heatsink: Running it doesn't mean I can fix it.
Paper Plane: Still, seeing what changed gives me more to work with than “trust us.”

records.bodyZh: 用途、限制、更正入口、版本记录。有人留言：“再加一项吧——维护的人睡觉以后，出了问题怎么办？”
records.bodyEn: Uses, limits, a correction channel, and version history. A reader adds: “One more item—what happens if something goes wrong while the maintainer is asleep?”

records.bodyZh: 二手服务器帖子下面，买家问能撑多少访问。卖家答：硬件我能给测试记录，服务要不要有人值班，得另算。
records.bodyEn: Under a used-server listing, a buyer asks how many visitors it can handle. The seller replies: I can provide hardware test records. Whether the service needs someone on call is a separate cost.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：要是有个程序什么都愿意答，我还真不一定敢用。
群友乙：但什么都不敢答，也帮不上忙。
群友丙：那就先说清楚，它在哪些事上拿不准。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: I'm not sure I'd trust a program willing to answer absolutely anything.
Member B: But one afraid to answer anything isn't much help.
Member C: It could start by explaining where it is uncertain.

records.bodyZh: 一个在线工具让用户先整理商品说明，再自行核对。有人说少打了许多字，也有人在留言区问，一句写错的承诺该找谁改。维护页新添了更正入口。
records.bodyEn: An online tool helps users draft product descriptions for their own review. Some say it saves typing; others ask whom to contact about an incorrect promise. The maintenance page now includes a correction channel.

records.bodyZh:
纸飞机：试了一小段，整理顺序挺省事，交付前还是改了两句。
晚班车：我关心出错后有没有人接着管。
半页纸：站上有版本记录，我先收藏，过阵子再看它改没改。
records.bodyEn:
Paper Plane: I tried a short passage. It saved some organising, though I changed two lines before delivery.
Late Bus: I care whether anyone keeps dealing with mistakes.
Half a Page: It has a change log. I've bookmarked it to see what actually gets fixed.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：有人分享了个文字小站，说会的和不会的都写在首页。
群友乙：说明写得好是第一步，后面也得照着做。
群友丙：我有空先试一段不重要的。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: Someone shared a writing site that lists both its uses and its limits.
Member B: Clear notes are a start. It still has to act on them.
Member C: I'll try a low-stakes paragraph when I have time.

records.bodyZh: 一条不清楚的说明已修订。旧版保留；提出问题的人收到回复。旁边还有一条“待核实”。这是一家小站今天留下的工作痕迹。
records.bodyEn: An unclear statement has been revised. The previous version remains, and the reporter has received a reply. Another entry is still marked “Needs checking.” This is the work a small site leaves behind today.

records.bodyZh: 有人挂出“网站文字维护”的兼职。留言只有一句：会写也得会改，最好别只按产出字数算钱。
records.bodyEn: A listing offers part-time work maintaining website text. One comment reads: writing includes correcting. It should not be paid only by the number of words produced.

records.titleZh: 同一个包，长出不同版本
records.bodyZh: 公开的模型包引来几份修改说明。有人补了错误示例，有人调整使用界面。下载者也提醒：同名文件不一定还是同一版本，使用前先看来源和记录。
records.bodyEn: A publicly available model package has drawn several modification notes. Some add examples of errors; others change the interface. Downloaders warn that a familiar filename may hide a different version. Check the source and history before using it.

records.bodyZh:
旧散热器：我愿意看别人怎么改，至少有东西能对照。
纸飞机：能不能把原版链接也留着？
半页纸：有人把说明删了只剩下载键，那就很难知道自己拿到什么。
records.bodyEn:
Old Heatsink: I want to see how people change it. At least there is something to compare.
Paper Plane: Could they keep a link to the original?
Half a Page: One page kept Download and removed the notes. That makes it hard to know what you're getting.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：现在有包能下，但我看要求，好像不是下完就能开。
群友乙：公开也得有人写清楚怎么用。
群友丙：还有，改坏了的别照样挂原作者名字。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: There's a package to download, but the requirements suggest it won't just run with a click.
Member B: A public release still needs instructions.
Member C: And if a modified version breaks things, don't pass it off under the original author's name.

records.bodyZh: 原始包、修改记录和已知问题分别列出。页面提醒：本站只能更新这里的版本，已经离开的副本不会跟着自动改变。
records.bodyEn: The original package, changes, and known issues are listed separately. The page notes: this site can update the version hosted here. Copies elsewhere do not change automatically.

records.bodyZh: 有人卖“包安装”。评论提醒：安装费不等于模型许可，也不代表原作者为这个安装服务担保。
records.bodyEn: Someone offers a package-installation service. A comment points out that the installation fee is not a model licence, and does not mean the original author endorses the service.

records.titleZh: 新论文之后，旧问题还在
records.bodyZh: 新的序列模型引起讨论。有人想尽快把研究变成工具，也有人问，测试、维护和申诉能不能一起准备好。这些争论没有在论文发布那天结束。
records.bodyEn: A new sequence model draws attention. Some want to turn the research into tools quickly; others ask whether testing, maintenance, and appeals can be prepared too. Publication day does not settle those arguments.

records.bodyZh:
晚班车：多测一些总没坏处吧。
半页纸：等着的人也有想解决的事，不能只说以后。
纸飞机：那就把还没做到的写清楚，别把等待说成保证，也别把发布说成已经解决。
records.bodyEn:
Late Bus: More testing should help.
Half a Page: People waiting have problems they want solved. “Later” isn't enough forever.
Paper Plane: Then name what is still missing. Waiting isn't a guarantee, and releasing isn't proof that the problem is solved.

records.bodyZh:
群友甲：昨晚的新论文，你们看到了吗？
群友乙：先收藏，今天还得上班。
群友丙：真变成好用的东西再叫我，我先把眼前这份表格做完。
records.bodyEn:
Member A: Did you see the new paper last night?
Member B: Bookmarked it. Still have work today.
Member C: Tell me when it becomes something useful. I have this spreadsheet to finish first.

records.bodyZh: 这个词的译法已改；旧版保留在历史记录里。留言：“以前从这儿抄走的人，会知道改过吗？”站长把更正放到了首页。
records.bodyEn: This term has been corrected; the old version remains in the history. A reader asks: “Will people who copied it earlier know?” The owner adds a correction notice to the home page.

records.bodyZh: 新的一天仍有人问显卡成色，也有人在卖一把旧椅子。
records.bodyEn: On a new day, people still ask about the condition of graphics cards, and someone is selling an old chair.

records.titleZh: 一种不依赖循环的序列模型：Transformer论文公开
records.titleEn: A sequence model without recurrence: the Transformer paper is public.
records.bodyZh:
一篇名为《Attention Is All You Need》的预印本于6月12日公开。研究团队提出主要依靠注意力机制处理序列的新架构，并报告了机器翻译实验中的结果与训练方式。它能把哪些工作做得更好，又有哪些地方尚不清楚，讨论才刚开始。

历史资料摘要；预印本首次公开2017-06-12（UTC），本页日期2017-06-13。下方人物与帖子为游戏原创，不是历史引文。
records.bodyEn:
A preprint titled Attention Is All You Need was made public on June 12. Its authors propose a sequence architecture built around attention and report results and training methods for machine translation. What work it might improve, and where its limits lie, are questions the discussion is only beginning to explore.

Original summary of historical material. First preprint: June 12, 2017 (UTC); page date: June 13, 2017. The characters and posts below are original fiction, not historical quotations.

records.bodyZh: 结构看起来更整齐了，想等复现实验。
records.bodyEn: The architecture looks simpler. I'd like to see replication.

records.bodyZh: 先别从两项翻译实验跳到所有工作都会变。
records.bodyEn: Let's not jump from translation experiments to claims about every job.
